events.title: Slotbound Has Reached 50,000 Wishlists!
events.summary: Slotbound has surpassed 50,000 wishlists!When I first started developing this game on my own, I never imagined it would reach this many people. This milestone was only possible because of everyone who played the demo, shared feedback and reviews, and told others about the game.I’ll keep working hard to make Slotbound more fun and polished as we move toward the full release.Thank you so much!

events.title: Slotbound Demo Is Available Now!
events.summary: The free demo for Slotbound is now available on Steam!Slotbound is a roguelite auto-battler defense game where you spin a 3x3 slot machine to summon units, absorb weaker allies to strengthen your army, and prepare for increasingly dangerous enemy waves.Spin to Summon Your ArmyEvery spin can change your strategy.Summon Warriors, Archers, Mages, and other units from the slot machine. Build a balanced army, or absorb your weaker units into a single fighter and turn them into an unstoppable monster.
